decisions.reason: After several years, this distant and very niche submarine line has likely had enough time to prove itself, and if it still falls short of aspiration levels management would reallocate resources to stronger core LED businesses and new development.

Even though it uses the firm's lighting know-how, the medical examination light sits outside its main industrial and building focus, so a continued gap versus aspirations would prompt withdrawal in favor of closer core opportunities.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires match the firm's industrial and maritime customers and certified engineering strengths very well, so they would normally be retained unless results clearly worsened.

A pendant office luminaire is firmly within the established offer and the firm's energy-efficient LED direction, so management is likely to keep it unless portfolio comparisons show weak performance or redundancy.

The premium pendant line is close to the core business and supports an innovative, higher-value market position, making continued retention more likely than exit unless it persistently misses aspiration levels.
